trust.study: Answers come from your college’s material. Sources are linked.
trust.career: Answers come from your college’s records. Sources are linked.
trust.title: How answers work
trust.sources: Every answer is built from what your college has: subject material for Study; drives, company pages, seniors’ write-ups, career paths and your own record for Career. The numbers in an answer are its sources; open one to check it.
trust.refuse: If your college’s material does not cover a question, the answer says so instead of guessing. Predictions (a salary you will get, your chances of selection) are never answered.
trust.mistakes: Answers are written by AI and can be wrong. Check the sources, and ask a senior or your teacher when it matters.
trust.private: Your conversations are yours: nobody else at your college reads them. You can delete them here.
